title: Key principles of sign design

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Limit wayfinding to a coherent set of elements so visitors can recognize and follow signs quickly.
strategic_value: A shared logo, Medium type and icon vocabulary can unify Helsinki buildings with different interiors.
demonstration: This expanded webpage-section capture lists four main signage elements above a photograph of black-and-white overhead and freestanding signs in a corridor.
practical_value: Begin a signage scheme with the specified logo, Medium type, black/white palette and icons.
